◆ Relic Enhancement ◆
● In the Inventory or character building screen, you can consume credits and Relic EXP Materials to enhance Relics.
● You can also use Relics directly as EXP materials. However, if the Relic used as material has already been enhanced, only a portion of the experience it gained will be provided.
● The higher the rarity of a relic, the higher its enhancement level cap.
● Each enhancement level increases the main stat. At Enhancement Levels 3/6/9/<unbreak>12</unbreak>/<unbreak>15</unbreak>, a new sub-stat is randomly added. If four sub-stats already exist, one will be randomly increased instead.

◆ Relic Reroll ◆
● When a Relic of 5-star rarity is enhanced to level <unbreak>15</unbreak>, Variable Dice can be consumed to reroll it.
● After rerolling, the Relic's sub-stat types will remain the same, but their enhancement counts will be randomly changed, and their values randomized.
● Once the reroll result is generated, Trailblazers can choose to use the new stats or retain the original ones. If the original stats are retained, the materials consumed will not be refunded.

◆ Relic Reroll Stats Block ◆
● When rerolling a Relic, you can consume an Interference Key to block 1 Subsidiary Stat. The blocked Subsidiary Stat will not be enhanced during this phase.
● If the blocked Subsidiary Stat has been enhanced at least once before rerolling, this stat will be reset to a random unenhanced value after the reroll. If the blocked Subsidiary Stat has never been enhanced before rerolling, its value will remain unchanged after the reroll.
